summary: Implementation plan for creating a pre-edit restore point and upgrading Dizi Urdu into a native-feeling Progressive Web App (PWA) with vite-plugin-pwa, static app icons and splash screen, per-page Admin status bar controls, custom install popout + settings install option, home screen shortcuts, enhanced video player hardware APIs (auto-landscape, Wake Lock, MediaSession, PiP), native share, haptics, offline caching, and mobile safe-area polish.
